en: Vintage black‑and‑white/sepia aerial view of a large institutional complex and surrounding town. In the foreground stands a long, multi‑storey classical building with a central gable and arched ground floor, framed by trees. Behind it is an expansive courtyard enclosed by barracks‑like buildings. Residential houses and tree‑lined streets extend to the sides, and open fields and low hills stretch into the distance. Red printed German text is at the top of the card.
